- Look into your legal options - defamation, libel, or slander laws may provide recourse in some cases, but consulting an attorney would be advisable.

The most important thing is to remain calm, avoid reacting emotionally, and take measured steps to protect yourself. I wish you the very best in resolving this difficult situation. Please don't hesitate to seek further support if you need it.
